prompt:
Create TC-SKIN-A4 / Illustrated Cloth Raster Master for the existing Town Center material pilot. One NEW actual raster texture painting is required. Previous geometric maze cloth attempts are rejected. The quiet cloth SVG is also rejected as the production source: do not handwrite SVG, rectangles, paths, CSS patterns or a screenshot of markup. Generate the image with an image model, and expose its actual standalone raster artwork in the page.

PLATFORM: Desktop art-source review.
PAGE STRUCTURE: one short title, one large original raster image and a short caption outside its pixels. No other content.

IMAGE DESCRIPTION:
An edge-to-edge orthographic painted texture of matte dyed ancient linen fabric, matching the muted cloth of the original town_center banners in BLDG-01 IMAGE 5eaec90d6212477cb95917458d523044. Close view of soft irregular natural flax fibres, fine fibrous fuzz, tiny thread ends and very restrained uneven pigment absorption. Most yarns gently flow horizontally; tiny organic short fibres provide subtle depth. Overall calm, quiet, plain cloth, extremely low-contrast surface detail. No geometric design, no regular grid drawing, no crosshatch paths, no circuit traces, no maze, no random rectangular blocks, no emblem, no architecture, no banner silhouette, no cloth edges, no drapery folds, no border or global gradient. Fill every edge of the 1024px square.
Illustrated GAME TEXTURE craftsmanship, with organic hand-painted microdetail and restrained small clustered marks that matches the existing architecture art, rather than a photographic PBR material or a flat vector graphic. Never turn this into a geometric pixel pattern. The material must remain quiet at reduced viewing size.
The downloadable raster image file must exist independently from the HTML and screenshot. Do not relabel a vector as a PNG source. Preserve all old artwork for provenance and leave all other assets alone.

screens.title:
A 1024x1024 completely flat, 100% full-bleed orthogonal 2D top-down planar painted texture of authentic matte dyed ancient linen banner cloth, matching the muted blue cloth banners seen on the town_center building in {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_34}}. 

CRAFT & STYLE:
- Illustrated retro game texture painting with soft, organic hand-painted microdetail and restrained clustered marks matching 16-bit retro isometric strategy game art.
- NOT a flat SVG graphic, NOT a procedural pattern, NOT a geometric grid, NOT vector rectangles, NOT a 3D PBR photo, NOT noisy photographic grain.
- Soft, irregular natural flax fibers, delicate fibrous fuzz, subtle organic thread slubs, tiny frayed hair ends, and gentle uneven natural pigment dye absorption.
- Horizontal yarn orientation: most flax yarns gently flow horizontally across the surface with subtle undulating fiber waviness, interwoven with faint vertical structural binder fibers.
- Calm, quiet, plain cloth with extremely low contrast. It reads from a distance as a solid uniform dyed blue banner fabric, with organic textile nuance visible upon close inspection.

COLOR PALETTE (Living Settlement 28-color restricted palette):
- Dominant base: matte dyed slate blue (#527B8C).
- Gentle fiber highlights: soft muted sky-slate (#688C9C, #7A9EAE).
- Restrained weave lowlights and shadow crevices: deep slate navy (#436675, #355260).
- Pure matte, low-saturation hand-dyed ancient textile look.

STRICT NEGATIVE EXCLUSIONS:
- NO circuit traces, NO maze pathways, NO labyrinth patterns, NO geometric right-angle lines, NO rectangular pixel blocks, NO tartan or plaid checks, NO high-contrast crosshatching.
- NO vector flat shapes, NO shiny highlights, NO specular reflections.
- NO banner silhouette, NO flag contour, NO hanging drapery folds, NO fabric ripples, NO shadows of folds, NO wooden poles, NO hanging ropes, NO tassels, NO fringe, NO embroidered crests, NO heraldic symbols, NO text or lettering.
- NO borders, NO margins, NO frames, NO vignette darkening at corners, NO global lighting gradients.
- 100% full-bleed: the painted organic linen cloth texture fills the entire square from border to border across all 4 edges.
